title: Thapa2025
description: A scalp EEG dataset of self-paced (freewill) reach-and-grasp motor execution recorded from 23 healthy right-handed participants across 49 sessions, yielding 6808 trials. On each trial, participants freely chose one of four cups (two water-filled, two empty) and the timing of the movement, defining four target classes. The dataset supports brain-machine interface research on movement decoding. This BIDS version was prepared for use with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus system and actiCAP snap active gel electrodes (31 EEG channels, 4 EOG channels, plus accelerometer and audio cue channels), referenced to Cz, using the standard 10-20 montage. Audio cues marked the start and end of each self-paced reach-and-grasp trial. Each participant completed up to 3 sessions of 5 runs.
